title: The Dog House and Tuxedo dance hall with Octave Crosby
summary: He describes working the Dog House and Tuxedo for Eddie Groeschel, and the earlier Entertainers lineup with David Jones.

Yeah, I remember. See, Pierron was playing down there and after he died and left, well then I went down there with Octave after I left the entertainers, after I left the entertainers. Then I went down there and worked with him and worked with that group. I was very seldom out of work. That's the time of this building that U.P. Long Bridge. You know this bridge.
